svg.title: video-format — Deepthink Animated Technical Video Presentation
svg.desc: Animated multi-act technical presentation showing multi-agent swarm failure modes, the Deepthink lockstep iteration timeline with live workspace panels, BSR trajectory evaluation, and log-scale compute scaling curves.

g.text: Branches iterate in lockstep while coordinating live in the shared workspace
nice catch, switching to spectral gap lower bound lambda_2 >= k - 2*sqrt(k-1)
convex_relax.lean compiled clean in Mathlib with zero sorrys
pulled hb1_m3_isomorphic_map.py into inductive step, 0 counterexamples
hold on Strategy-3 just tried a rank-6 relaxation and broke the upper bound
reverted Strategy-3 back to the iter_03 checkpoint, way cleaner from there
combining restored iter_03 base with cut invariant closes n > 8 ▎
left alone they will figure out:
how to complete a given task & verify it
how to build & strengthen their own verification
how to find gaps in their work
Put them in a multi-agent system
and they fail terribly at various dimensions
failing to carry forward high signal state
failing to build upon other agents' work
Multi-Agent Swarm · Isolated Local Loops Without Shared State
Depending on the branch, clean it up by either distilling, pruning or evolving its contents
worthy of another window · fold memory bank
Then we give these decisions to strategies-update-agent and proceed with the evolved strategies.
